{{Quote|Most Togrutas are not independent. Many species are under the impression that Togrutas are venomous... Togrutas enjoy eating thiamars, small rodent-like creatures... well, that's not fair. I'm not like that at all.|Ahsoka Tano to [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], while reading from a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]|<ref name="Clone Wars novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Togruta''' were a [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species from the planet [[Shili/Legends|Shili]]. The species exhibited [[Lekku/Legends|head-tails]], called lekku, which were similar to those of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]].<ref name="Clone Wars novel" /> Unlike Twi'leks, a Togruta's lekku were part of their [[Montral/Legends|montrals]] and ran parallel to the head, creating the appearance of wearing a [[Wikipedia:Nemes|headdress]]. Togruta were also distinguished by their montrals - large, hollow, horn-like projections from the top of their heads that provided a form of passive echolocation. In order to protect themselves from dangerous predators and to hunt their own prey, Togruta banded together in tribes and relied on their natural pigmentation to disrupt and confuse slow-witted beasts. Togruta worked well in large groups, and individualism was seen as abnormal within their culture, although it was also a necessary quality in leaders.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:KirosTogruta-TCWs4BR2.png|thumb|left|180px|A male Togruta carrying a female]]
Togruta had rusty skin tones ranging in hue from blue to red to green, with white pigmentation on their faces<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and grayish lips. While not all had this feature, white stripes also adorned various parts of their bodies, including their chests, legs, backs, arms and montrals.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> The pattern of stripes were, like fingerprints, different in each individual. This pattern was a phenotype left over from their ancestors' camouflage that helped them to blend in with their natural surroundings, especially the red-and-white [[turu-grass]] which dominated [[Shili/Legends|Shili's]] scrublands. The stripes on a Togruta's lekku or montrals may become more radiantly colored after vigorous activity. This would be the equivalent of getting red in the face.<ref name="Clone Wars novel" />

Togruta's heads bore two montrals with three, and on rare occasions, four<ref name="Star Wars: General Grievous">''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic: Knights of Suffering">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Knights of Suffering]]''</ref> large lekku, whose stripes were darker than those of the montrals.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> Togruta had the ability to sense proximity and movement of physical objects around them by means of their hollow montrals, which detected space ultrasonically. Young Togruta's montrals and posterior lek did not fully develop until adolescence, when their montrals grew curved and their third lek grew to a similar length.

As predators, Togruta had sharp canine teeth, which they used to painlessly kill [[thimiar]]s, their primary prey, causing the creatures' post-mortem death spasms. This gave outsiders the false impression that Togruta were venomous. However, Togruta did nothing to dispel this misconception and even took advantage of the intimidating presence it gave them. In addition, Togruta were also capable of seeing objects<ref name="Clone Wars novel" /> immensely far away from them, too remote for any human to see.<ref name="Overlords">{{TCW|Overlords}}</ref>

==Culture==
===Overview===
<div style="float:right">[[File:Ashla.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Ashla (Jedi)/Legends|Ashla]], a Togruta youngling]]</div>
Togruta had a strong sense of unity and togetherness. On their native homeworld of Shili, they relied on each other and banded together to stand against the massive monsters which hunted them, such as the [[Akul/Legends|akul]]. It is said that the creatures of Shili most often attacked in groups, which gave even more reason for the native Togruta to work together. While most of Shili was covered in the scrublands, where the Togruta hunted their herbivorous prey, the Togruta lived in small communities in the forest valleys, where the canopies kept them out of sight.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Togruta were known for their habit of not wearing shoes; they believed in a spiritual connection to the land, and believed that wearing shoes severed that bond. Togruta were also known for their belief that those who fell behind should be left to fend for themselves, because it was nature's way. Other sentient species found this particular belief quite barbaric. Those who led within a pack had a difficult time fulfilling their goals due to the risk of becoming individualistic. As hunters, the Togruta arrayed the pelts and teeth of their game as a sign of pride and maturation. Special pride was taken in the teeth of [[Akul/Legends|akul]] that a Togruta had defeated as an individual. These teeth were often made into jewelry, such as an [[akul-tooth headdress]] or a necklace, which also incorporated metals, stones, and pearls found on Shili.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> Other Togruta, such as [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], wore the [[Togruta sash]] with their [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary" /> Togruta spoke the [[Togruti/Legends|Togruti]] language, which contained a few elements of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="UAA" />

===Personality===
Togruta were tranquil and silent, though true warriors in appropriate situations.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> Their fidelity to their beliefs was honorable, as was their harmony within large groups. Togruta, not surprisingly, excelled at teamwork and association with different cultures. To an extent, Togruta had an aversion to isolation and made efforts to keep friends near for companionship.<ref name="Clone Wars novel" />

==History==
{{Quote|No more than all Togrutans are pacifists.|Darth Plagueis on the Togrutas{{'}} pacifism|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Sparatist_Kiros.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Separatists arrive on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]].]]
The Togruta were discovered by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].<ref name="theess">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> At some point in their history they established a major pacifist colony on the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]].<ref name="slaves">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic]]''</ref> During the [[Old Republic era]], the species orchestrated the [[Togruta Uprising]], an event later pacified by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran|Kilran]].<ref name="HolonetOld-grand-moff-kilran">''{{HolonetOld|biographies|grand-moff-kilran|Grand Moff Kilran}}''</ref> Togruta as a whole possessed a special affinity for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], though they had slightly less than the normal number of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]]. It was believed that this affinity was produced from their heightened spatial awareness imparted by their montrals and their role as hunters. Their sense of spiritual connection with the land also heightened their connection with the environment, thus leading to a greater ability to feel the Force. The species had contributed members to the Jedi Order practically since its beginning. A majority of the Togruta species within the Jedi Order were females, though males were not unheard of.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

A colony of Togruta who attempted to escape the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] made lives for themselves on Kiros, only to be taken away as slaves by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]].<ref name="Kidnapped" /> Republic forces intervened and rescued the colonists at the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|Battle of Kadavo]].<ref name="Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>

==Togruta in the galaxy==
[[File:AhsokaTano-Cnet.png|thumb|right|270px|Ahsoka Tano, Togruta Padawan of the Jedi Order]]
One of the earliest known Togruta in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Raana Tey]], a member of the [[Jedi Covenant]], who participated in the [[Padawan Massacre]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] early in the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="[[Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic: Commencement]]">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Commencement]]''</ref>

During the Clone Wars one of the most well known Togruta was Shaak Ti, a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], who participated in many of the battles during the war. Ti was one of the few survivors of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and helped save [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from execution.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> Shaak Ti also protected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], though she was unable to prevent his capture by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Ti survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and went into exile on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] where she trained her apprentice [[Maris Brood]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Another Togruta Jedi during the Clone Wars was Ahsoka Tano, the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

Other Togruta padawans during the Clone Wars were Ashla, a member of the [[Bear Clan]] trained by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]],<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" /> [[Deran Nalual]], a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] that survived the initiation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]],<ref name="[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> and [[Codi Ty]], a male Togruta who saved a number of younglings from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], though he was expelled for seeking vengeance.<ref name="Star Wars: General Grievous" />

Records indicated that there were no known Togruta within the early [[New Jedi Order]], though at least [[Unidentified Togruta youngling|one youngling]] survived the [[Massacre at Ossus]]<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 1: Broken, Part 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> along with [[Asaak Dan]], a male Togruta Jedi.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 26: The Hidden Temple, Part 2 (cover art)">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>
